payload.text: **LESSONS candidates from 2026-09-17, vc's call at a fold.** (u) The pipefail early-reader class recurred in NEW code the morning after LESSONS already carried it: `cfg_list | while ... | grep -qx -- -` in _cfg_release_problems accepted a bad list 3 of 3 at a 100 KB item with pipefail on. (v) A review's clean covers what its contract let it run: critic-shell does not run shellcheck by contract, and dc's SC2209 on `verb=cut` was a real lint failure behind a critic review with no warning about it. (w) A check run in zsh with `mapfile` compared ZERO paths and printed `differ:` blank; only the population count on the same line showed it. (x) Replacing a case statement with a split list took on the caller's IFS for the second time in two days (cfg_release_list, cfg_release_problems) -- lesson (p) did not install. (y) A test comparing `[ "$(reader)" = "" ]` passes when the reader fails; capture into a variable first so errexit sees the status.
